originalTitle: Robinhood shares fall 4% as crypto slump weighs on profits, offsetting gains in new businesses
summary: Robinhood's third-quarter revenue met expectations, fueled by the company's expansion into options, predictions markets and other financial services.
content:
Robinhood shares fell 4% in after-hours trading as investors digested weaker-than-expected third-quarter earnings despite growth in options trading and prediction markets.

Here's how the brokerage performed in its quarter ended Sept. 30, compared with Wall Street estimates, based on a survey of analysts by LSEG:

Robinhood's net income fell to $468 million, or 51 cents per share, from $556 million, or 61 cents per share, a year ago. Revenue represented a 12% increase from $1.27 billion in the same quarter last year.

Despite that gain, transaction-based revenue of $867 million came in below Wall Street estimates from StreetAccount of $879 million, putting the focus on whether Robinhood can sustain momentum across its trading businesses and reduce its reliance on volatile market activity.

Robinhood has been diversifying its business as it tries to expand its brokerage app into a broader financial services platform. Options trading and event contracts have become increasingly important sources of transaction revenue, while the company has continued to invest in wealth management, subscriptions and other offerings.

Transaction-based revenue grew 19% from the same period last year to $867 million, driven primarily by a more than 500% increase in event contracts revenue. Additionally, options revenue grew 31% to $399 million and equities revenue rose 41% to $121 million.

Those gains were partially offset by cryptocurrency revenue, which fell 55% to $120 million.

Chief Financial Officer Shiv Verma told CNBC event contracts on crypto movements did well in the quarter, offering investors another way to express a view on crypto despite the slump in prices and spot trading.

Net deposits on the Robinhood platform totaled $15.7 billion for the quarter, equal to a 17% annualized growth rate based on total platform assets at the end of Q2 2026. Over the past year, net deposits totaled $71 billion, representing 21% growth compared with total platform assets at the end of Q3 2025.

—With reporting from CNBC's Robert Hum and Kate Rooney
chineseTitle: 由于加密货币暴跌影响利润，Robinhood 股价下跌 4%，抵消了新业务的收益
chineseSummary: 在公司向期权、预测市场和其他金融服务领域扩张的推动下，Robinhood 第三季度收入达到了预期。
chineseContent:
尽管期权交易和预测市场有所增长，但由于投资者消化了低于预期的第三季度收益，Robinhood 股价在盘后交易中下跌了 4%。

根据 LSEG 对分析师的调查，该券商在截至 9 月 30 日的季度中的表现与华尔街的预期相比如下：

Robinhood 的净利润从一年前的 5.56 亿美元（即每股 61 美分）降至 4.68 亿美元（即每股 51 美分）。收入较去年同期的 12.7 亿美元增长 12%。

尽管取得了这一收益，但基于交易的收入为 8.67 亿美元，低于华尔街根据 StreetAccount 估计的 8.79 亿美元，这使得人们关注 Robinhood 能否维持其交易业务的增长势头并减少对波动市场活动的依赖。

Robinhood 一直在实现业务多元化，试图将其经纪应用程序扩展到更广泛的金融服务平台。期权交易和事件合约已成为越来越重要的交易收入来源，同时该公司继续投资于财富管理、订阅和其他产品。

基于交易的收入较去年同期增长 19%，达到 8.67 亿美元，这主要是由于赛事合同收入增长超过 500%。此外，期权收入增长 31%，达到 3.99 亿美元，股票收入增长 41%，达到 1.21 亿美元。

这些收益被加密货币收入部分抵消，该收入下降了 55% 至 1.2 亿美元。

首席财务官 Shiv Verma 告诉 CNBC，有关加密货币走势的活动合约在本季度表现良好，为投资者提供了另一种表达加密货币观点的方式，尽管价格和现货交易暴跌。

Robinhood 平台本季度净存款总额为 157 亿美元，相当于 2026 年第二季度末平台总资产的年化增长率为 17%。过去一年，净存款总额为 710 亿美元，较 2025 年第三季度末的平台总资产增长 21%。

—CNBC 罗伯特·胡姆 (Robert Hum) 和凯特·鲁尼 (Kate Rooney) 的报道
